title: [29.x]Source Currency Inconsistency for LCY Postings and cash posting on sales documents
summary: Fixes inconsistent Source Currency values on G/L entries for LCY postings and for cash posting on sales documents. The fix changes Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in the W1 layer and several localized layers in the 29.x release.
key_points: Corrects how source currency is set when posting in local currency
Fixes the source currency inconsistency for cash posting on sales documents
Changes codeunit 12 Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in W1 and the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
Adds tests to ERMSourceCurrency in the W1, CZ, ES, IT and RU test layers
